remarks:
Excellent investment opportunity or owner-occupant property in a highly desirable location just minutes from the University at Buffalo, major bus routes, shopping, dining, and the subway. Situated on a quiet, tree-lined street, this well-maintained 2-unit property offers strong rental appeal and broad marketability. Each fully furnished apartment features 2 bedrooms, 1 full bath, a bright and inviting living room, and a spacious eat-in kitchen designed for comfortable everyday living. Both stoves and refrigerators are included, making this a truly turnkey opportunity for investors and homeowners alike. Outdoor amenities include a welcoming covered front porch, a pleasant partially fenced backyard ideal for relaxing, gardening, or entertaining, and a freshly painted 2-car garage with additional driveway parking for ample off-street parking. Laundry hookups are conveniently located in the basement. A major capital improvement was completed with all new sewer lines installed in March 2026, providing added value and peace of mind. Ideal for student housing, owner-occupants, or investors seeking dependable rental
income in a consistently high-demand location.
